examples.intent: Submit an action and check the redirect, the flash and the row
examples.code:
<q:test name="create a task" page="/">
  <test:submit action="create" title="Buy bread" />
  <test:expect redirect="/" flash="Created: Buy bread" />
  <test:expect table="tasks" count="1" where="title = 'Buy bread'" />
</q:test>

<q:test name="title too short" page="/">
  <test:submit action="create" title="x" />
  <test:expect error="title" message="Must be at least 3 characters" />
</q:test>

examples.intent: A row given, a user signed in, a page visited
examples.code:
<q:test name="the admin sees drafts" page="/admin">
  <test:given table="posts" title="Draft" is_published="0" />
  <test:as user="Ana" role="admin" id="1" />
  <test:visit />
  <test:expect text="Draft" />
  <test:expect queries="at most 3" />
</q:test>

examples.intent: Several tests in a file, with comments
examples.code:
<!-- tasks -->
<q:test name="a"><test:visit filter="open" /><test:expect var="filter" value="open" /></q:test>
<q:test name="b"><test:expect history="tasks" action="create" op="insert" count="0" /></q:test>
